title: Fix post-signup buffering and implement Jobseeker Profile Setup (Fresher/Experienced with up to 5 experiences) using manual auth

requirements.text: Fix the infinite loading/buffering after manual signup so that users reliably navigate to the Profile Setup page and can interact with the form immediately (no spinner loop).

quotes: Not getting next page after sign up its buffering
I want user to get next page

acceptanceCriteria: After a successful signup on the Signup page, the app navigates to /profile-setup and renders the Profile Setup form (not an indefinite loader).

If the Profile Setup page cannot determine profile completeness (e.g., because a backend profile fetch is unauthorized/unavailable), the UI must not block with an infinite spinner; it should fall back to the manual-auth stored state for completeness checks and allow profile setup.
Protected routes (jobseeker/employer) must not get stuck rendering only a loading indicator due to profile completeness checks.

requirements.text: Implement the Jobseeker Profile Setup form fields and behavior as specified: collect Name, Mobile Number, Email ID, Current Location, and an Experience status dropdown (Fresher or Experienced). If Experienced is selected, allow the user to add/edit/remove up to 5 experience entries, each with Company Name, Designation, Process, Last Salary, and total duration (months or years).

quotes: If Jobseeker then Name, Mobile No, email id, Current location, 2 dropdown Experience or Fresher, if experienced then Company Name, Designation, Process, Last salary, total month or year worked, user can add upto 5 experience.

acceptanceCriteria: Profile Setup for role=jobseeker displays inputs for Name, Mobile Number, Email ID, Current Location, and an Experience Status dropdown with exactly two options: Fresher and Experienced.
When Experience Status = Fresher, the experience-entry UI is hidden and no experience entries are required.
When Experience Status = Experienced, the experience-entry UI is shown and the user can add up to 5 entries; attempting to add a 6th entry is prevented with clear English validation messaging.

Each experience entry contains fields: Company Name, Designation, Process, Last Salary, and Duration (with an explicit months/years choice or a clearly labeled single duration input that captures months or years).
The submit button remains disabled while saving, and validation errors are shown in English when required fields are missing.

requirements.text: Persist manual-auth profile completion state so that after completing Profile Setup the user is routed to the correct next page and will not be repeatedly forced back into /profile-setup on subsequent visits.

quotes: I want user to get next page

acceptanceCriteria: On successful Profile Setup submit, the app navigates to /jobseeker/dashboard for jobseekers and /employer/candidates for employers.
Manual-auth stored account/session state is updated to indicate the profile is complete (so ProtectedRoute no longer redirects the user back to /profile-setup).
Refreshing the browser after completing profile does not send the user back to /profile-setup (unless they explicitly clear storage/log out).

constraints: Do not use Internet Identity for signup/login (manual auth only), per user request.

Do not edit files under frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, and frontend/src/components/ui/* (compose existing UI components instead).
Keep all user-facing text in English.
nonGoals: Implement backend-based manual authentication APIs (signup/login/logout/validateSession) in Motoko.
Add or complete job posting and job application features.
Change employer profile requirements beyond what is necessary to prevent buffering/redirect loops.
